scores._method: virality_predictor on the L1 concept clip. Free on ultra, video only, 16s cap, 2 concurrent.
scores._read_this_before_comparing: These are L1 scores and they are only comparable to each other. The nine clips measured on Sep 5 were finished renders and scored 46-56 with a clean dark/bright split. These four are 720p budget renders of dark-ground compositions and they all land at 46-49 — the tier flattened the luminance advantage rather than the compositions losing it. Do not read a 47 here as the same thing as a 47 there.
scores._what_L1_did_show: Every one of the four peaks in its last three seconds and every one is weakest in the hook window: hooks 30-33 against overalls 46-49. The shot order buries its best second at the end, which is right for a film and wrong for a post. S11 is the exception that proves the rule — it peaks at second 7 and carries the lowest mind-wandering of the four (0.604), because it is the one shot that gets darker and closer as it runs. Sustain is 98-100 across the board, so retention still needs no work.

concept_ladder.L1: 720p, budget engine (seedance_2_0_mini), 10s, from the two anchors. Tests whether the A frame can reach the B frame at all. Done 2026-09-08 for the 11 seam-bearing shots.
concept_ladder.L2: 720p, the shot's real engine from the SHOTS row, real duration, chained from L1's rendered last frame. Tests the seam between shots, not inside them.
concept_ladder.final: 1080p or 4K on the engine in the SHOTS row, chained from the rendered last frame of the previous shot. Only after Gate C freezes the timing.
concept_ladder.why: Three passes on rising cost. A failure found at L1 costs one budget clip; the same failure found at final costs a 4K generation and the shot behind it.

credits.why_this_now_decides_the_plan: 23 final clips on premium engines at 1080p or 4K, with a second attempt on most and six on S20, does not fit in 2323 credits. The API cannot pay for the final pass. The web app's unlimited allowance can.
